_readme: P1 institution access (decided 2026-10-02): aware → knows a member → guest → invited back → sponsored candidate → member. A forward step needs the five-part gate: a specific inviter, an existing relationship, relevant work in the domain, demonstrated usefulness, and an inviter willing to take the risk. Fame never counts. Months and costs PROPOSED P1-06. 'work' names a commission whose completion is the relevant work.

guest.offer: Felix sends a boy with a message: the men of the guild eat together at Ostia on the Ides, and he has told them about Cassianus's pump. "Come as my guest. Bring nothing but an appetite and a coin for the wine."
guest.scene: The supper is in a long room above a warehouse at Ostia, the couches set by rank. You are at the bottom, next to a rope-maker who talks about nothing but hemp. A shipper complains that his pumps leak like Cassianus's did. Felix catches your eye across the room and does not come over.

again.offer: Felix again: "They asked whether you'd come back. Not all of them kindly. Come anyway."
again.scene: This time the shipper with the leaking pumps saves you a place. The guild's quaestor reads out who owes dues and who has died; the members pass a box for a widow. Someone asks where you are from, and does not believe the answer.

sponsor.offer: Felix walks you to the river after supper. "I'll put my name to you, if you want it. If you shame me, it's my name they remember."
sponsor.scene: Felix stands up at the next supper and says your name, your trade and what you did for Cassianus. Two men speak for you. One speaks against: foreigners take work from members. The vote is put off a month, as these things are.

admit.scene: The guild takes you in. You swear by the guild's genius before the shrine in the hall, pay your entry, and hear what you owe: dues each year, your place at the suppers, a share when a member is buried, help when a member is in trouble, and the guild's word in your disputes. Felix pours the first cup.

paths.decline: You send word to Felix that you can't come. He doesn't ask again for a while.
